name: Commercial & Corporate Banking
description: Commercial and industrial loans, commercial real estate, small business, and corporate relationship lending.

dimensions.name: segment
dimensions.description: Small business, middle market, large corporate

dimensions.name: property_type
dimensions.description: CRE property type (office, multifamily, retail, industrial)

metrics.name: loans_outstanding
metrics.description: Funded loan balances at a point in time

metrics.name: commitments
metrics.description: Total committed lines at a point in time

metrics.name: loan_spread
metrics.description: Weighted average spread over the reference rate

metrics.name: criticized_ratio
metrics.description: Criticized and classified loans divided by total loans

metrics.name: dscr
metrics.description: Net operating income divided by debt service

conventions.rule: Distinguish funded (outstanding) from unfunded (commitment) exposure; do not add them without stating the conversion.
Spreads are quoted over a named reference rate (e.g., SOFR); state it.
Aggregate to the obligor or group before concentration analysis; one obligor can hold many facilities.

insight_rules.reason: Spreads are balance-weighted averages; decompose into mix and rate effects instead.

caveats.text: CRE collateral values are appraisal-based and lag markets; current LTVs may be stale.

chart_conventions.rule: Show industry concentration as a sorted bar of share of exposure; highlight names above the concentration limit.

review.notes: Drafted from public, general industry conventions; not yet reviewed by a named domain owner.
